text:
Marie (CSM): Heads up — Albatross (mid-market, ~120 seats) usage is down ~42% over the last 30d and their renewal is in 28 days. I think a short 'de-risk corridor' would be better than a full concessions package: 2-week enablement + temporary downgrade corridor + conditional credits. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Rachel (CS Ops): Saw the same on health dashboard. Onboarding completion stalled at 48% after week 2. Cohort heatmap: https://go.redwood/albatross-heatmap :eyes:

Jason (AE): I can take an exec touch on Wed 3pm PT to buy runway. Need a couple of crisp ROI bullets — any quick numbers on token/cost reduction if they enable caching/batching?

Devin (SE): Infra config shows prefix/KV cache disabled in their Dedicated settings. That would explain higher token spend and latency spikes. I can enable a canary toggle and run a 48h trial. Prep checklist below.

Devin (SE): ```
- Canary: enable prefix_cache=true on gpool-12
- Batching: set max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat routes
- Monitor: 95th pct latency, median latency, token spend per session
- Rollback: `rb_cache_toggle.sh` to revert if any regressions
```

Luis (Product): They're also reporting inconsistent reranker outputs since the recent model bump. If we capture 3 failing prompts/examples we can triage model variant vs prompt UX. CS can drop examples into the shared doc.

Marie (CSM): Draft of the 2-week de-risk corridor plan: 
- Week 0: Exec call + commit to 48h caching trial (Jason/Devin)
- Week 1: Two 30-min hands-on enablement sessions for power users (Devin leads)
- Week 1: Capture 3-5 failing prompts for product investigation (Marie owns)
- Week 2: Offer a one-month downgrade corridor with data & support preserved OR a 10% credit on overage if they sign a 6-month renewal (negotiated by Jason)

Marie (CSM): Owners & timeline: 
- Exec call: Jason — Wed 3pm PT (prep bullets by Tue EOD)
- Canary toggle & metrics: Devin — start Wed 4pm PT, 48h run
- Enablement sessions: Devin + Rachel — schedule for next Thu/Fri
- Feedback capture (prompts + logs): Marie + customer — collect by next Tue
- Commercial: Jason — draft downgrade corridor language by Tue EOD

Rachel (CS Ops): Can we add a quick post-session survey: "Did this session resolve your primary blockers? (Y/N)" Need structured feedback to feed product triage.

Luis (Product): I'll review prompts/logs. If a model regression, we can repro on staging and involve inference team. Also flag if latency anomalies align with specific regions.

Jason (AE): I'll push the downgrade/credit offer but need an 'acceptable usage' baseline to negotiate. Marie — can you pull last 3 invoices and 30/60/90 usage?

Marie (CSM): Pulling invoices now, will upload into the shared plan doc. Prefer to keep this as a temporary runway — objective is to close renewal if adoption improves. :rocket:

reminder-bot: Meeting created — "Albatross exec check-in" Wed 3:00 PM PT (invite sent)

Devin (SE): I'll post trial results after 48h with 95th/median latency and token spend delta. If cache reduces token spend >20% that's a strong commercial lever. :+1:

Marie (CSM): If this goes well I'll add a lightweight template to micro-saves with tag `de-risk-corridor` so teams can reuse.

Rachel (CS Ops): +1, will prep the survey and scheduling links.

Jason (AE): Thanks team — I'll prepare stakeholder list for exec call and draft comms.

Marie (CSM): Closing loop — next updates here after exec call and after the 48h trial completes.
